_comment: Reviewed, sourced league labels for rows where Wikipedia's Division column did not parse (rendered empty). Keyed by player_id -> team_id -> league. Each is unambiguous from the club and era. Applied only when the collected league_id is 'unknown'.

barcelona.reason: Riquelme played for FC Barcelona in the Spanish top flight (La Liga) 2002-03.

villarreal.reason: Villarreal CF competed in La Liga throughout Riquelme's 2003-2007 spell (incl. the loan seasons).

bayern-munich.reason: Bayern Munich play in the German Bundesliga.

stuttgart.reason: VfB Stuttgart played in the Bundesliga during Lahm's 2003-2005 loan.
